name: Structure
description: Do by one action what you do to a note by hand: extract a passage or a list item into its own child block, sort a list inside a block, sort a block's children.

actions.label: Extract to a child block
actions.description: Make the passage (or the list item and its children) a new child of the note, and put !((child)) where it was

actions.label: Sort the selected list
actions.description: Sort the list items the passage touches, with their children. By title, or by with={"by":"price","order":"desc"}, or by the note's own [sort-by::] and [sort-order::]

actions.label: Sort the list in this block
actions.description: Sort the block's first list (with={"list":"2"}: the second), by title, with={"by":"price","order":"desc"}, or by the block's own [sort-by::] and [sort-order::]

actions.label: Sort the children
actions.description: Sort the block's child blocks by title, by created, or by a property: with={"by":"created","order":"desc"}, or the block's own [sort-by::] and [sort-order::]
